spag_note: SPaG marks ("[+ 3 SPaG marks]") are folded into the marks of the part they belong to (spag_marks recorded on the unit), so each booklet reconciles to its cover maximum.
source_question_count_basis: One scored unit per printed AQA part (e.g. 01.2). Optional Section C questions form choice groups of whole options with a choose count (Paper 1: two of three; Paper 2: Question 3 plus one of 4, 5, 6). The adapted June 2022 Paper 2 has one group whose options are Section B (Question 2) or Question 3 plus one of 4, 5, 6.
